# Goodform Web Studio

> Websites, systems and applications for businesses in Greater Manchester and across the UK.

## Services
- Starter website package: £199 one-off. Up to four standard pages, mobile-friendly design, one contact form, essential on-page SEO, help with website text, a simple starter logo if needed, one round of changes and 14 days of launch support. Domain and hosting are paid separately.
- Custom websites, applications and connected systems: scoped and quoted individually.
